primaryTarget: wasm/web with headed Playwright and WebGPU enabled
hypothesisMarkdown:
## Faded source-over layers composited directly Hypothesis

Layers of normal blend (faded groups, blurred ones fading in) were drawn over what is under them through tiny-skia's pipeline (a pattern shader, eight pixels at a time in single precision, staged). A direct loop computes the same: each channel and alpha over 255 in single precision, faded by the opacity unless it is 1, the destination times one less the source alpha plus the source, rounded to the nearest (ties to even, as every target tiny-skia supports rounds).\n\n**Tested mechanism:** direct source-over compositing at any opacity. **Allowed:** render compose, `over`, a unit test. **Forbidden:** other blends, masks, effects.
